caption: Two hundred meters each send 48 readings a day; the broker ingests 9,600 readings (0.6144 MB) a day and holds 90 days of raw data — 55.296 MB — then hands each meter out as its own virtual sensor to billing and leak analytics. Notice the broker is where readings pile up, and the virtual sensors are what applications actually talk to.

spec.title: Water-meter sensor cloud
spec.aria: 200 water meters each send 48 readings a day through a gateway to a cloud broker that ingests 9,600 readings (0.6144 MB) a day and stores 55.296 MB over 90 days, then exposes one virtual sensor per meter to billing and leak analytics.
